_README: Manifest for one table: `python3 tools/table_art.py build tables/<name>/table.json`.
Copy this file to tables/<name>/table.json and fill it in. Every number comes from tables/anchors.json.
raw/, final/ and preview/ default to subfolders of THIS file's folder - nothing is written elsewhere.
The build prints unit / final size / interior / target / status and exits non-zero on any MISMATCH.
A unit whose open interior is not exactly `rect` within 2 px is a MISMATCH - that check is the point.
_design: optional; defaults to the folder name, e.g. table_city
_backdrop: change this: assets/<this table's backdrop>.jpg - see tables/anchors.json assets_available

units._note: a casing around a group of rects. rect = interior = the game's rect; border = (L,T,R,B) drawn OUTSIDE it.
units._budget: must not exceed the free space in tables/anchors.md on any side

rails._note: an internal seam, cut from a unit's own bottom rail. Drawn AFTER the units or the casing covers it.

cards._note: a bezel drawn INSIDE the card rect, one file per card size. kind: field | hand | cpu

decor._note: art that is not a frame: edge brackets, ornaments. box = [x, y, w, h] on the canvas.
